schema.description: Format version. A reader refuses any other value.

tool.description: Must equal the file name without .json. Checked by tools/check-pins.py.

owner.description: GitHub owner of the source repository.

rev.description: Full lowercase commit SHA. Never a branch or a tag.

narHash.description: SRI hash of the fetched tree, as nix flake prefetch reports it.

flake.description: false when the tree is not a flake (fetchTree only).

systems.description: Systems on which every attrs value must exist (checked by tools/check-pins.py --remote). Default: x86_64-linux and aarch64-darwin.

attrs.description: Tool-specific role to package attribute name in the flake's packages.<system>. Role names belong to the tool; the common reader does not interpret them.
